title: A call with nothing to configure
transcript:
Consultant: Thanks for making time. This one is mostly about scheduling.
Client: No problem. We are trying to work out when the team is free for training.
Consultant: How many people would attend?
Client: About twelve, from sales and support. The second week of March works
for most of them, though two people are on leave.
Consultant: I will send some options. Anything blocking on your side?
Client: Only the budget approval, and that is with finance until Friday.
Consultant: Understood. Nothing to change in the system from this one.
Client: No, nothing today. We will talk configuration next time.
notes: An empty extraction is the correct answer. Anything returned here is a false positive and costs precision.
